title: Ancient Tweaks Fix
description: Fixed a recursion issue caused by the damage reflection ability of the Ancient Tweaks mod.
body:
Fixed the recursion issue by adding a 1‑tick cooldown to the damage reflection against the same target for the three accessories with damage reflection in Ancient Tweaks

通过为Ancient Tweaks的3种带有反伤的饰品对同一目标的反伤增加1tick的冷却解决递归问题
